youtube.chatMessage.description: Runs when someone writes in your YouTube live chat. Handy for replies or word triggers.

fields.contains: Only run when the message has this text in it, like "hello". Capital letters do not matter. Leave empty to run for every message.
fields.ignoreBot: Tick to skip messages written by your own bot account, so it does not react to itself.

variables.user: Name of the person who wrote
variables.isModerator: True if they are a moderator
variables.isMember: True if they are a channel member

youtube.superChat.description: Runs when a viewer pays for a Super Chat (a highlighted paid message). Good for a thank-you or an alert.

fields.minAmount: Only run for at least this much money, in the currency the viewer paid in. 0 means no minimum. Example: 5.
fields.maxAmount: Only run for at most this much money. 0 means no maximum.
fields.currency: Only run for this currency, as a 3-letter code like "USD" or "EUR". Empty runs for any currency.
fields.minTier: Only run for this level or higher. YouTube gives each Super Chat a color level from 1 (lowest) up. 0 runs for every level.

variables.amount: How much was paid, as a number
variables.amountText: The amount as YouTube shows it, like $5.00
variables.message: The text that came with it

youtube.superSticker.description: Runs when a viewer pays for a Super Sticker (a paid picture in chat). Good for a thank-you or an alert.

fields.minAmount: Only run for at least this much money, in the currency the viewer paid in. 0 means no minimum. Example: 2.
fields.maxAmount: Only run for at most this much money. 0 means no maximum.
fields.currency: Only run for this currency, as a 3-letter code like "USD" or "EUR". Empty runs for any currency.
fields.minTier: Only run for this level or higher. YouTube gives each Super Sticker a color level from 1 (lowest) up. 0 runs for every level.

variables.amount: How much was paid, as a number
variables.amountText: The amount as YouTube shows it

youtube.jewelsGifted.description: Runs when a viewer sends Jewels (YouTube's gifts for vertical live streams).

fields.minJewels: Only run when at least this many Jewels were sent. 0 runs for every gift. Example: 50.

variables.comboCount: How many times in a row (a combo)
variables.message: The text that came with it

youtube.newSponsor.description: Runs when someone becomes a new member of your YouTube channel (YouTube calls members "sponsors"). Good for a thank-you.

fields.level: Only run for membership levels whose name has this text in it, like "Gold". Empty runs for every level.
fields.upgrades: "Only upgrades" runs only when a member moves up to a higher level. "No upgrades" runs only for brand-new members. "Any" runs for both.

variables.isUpgrade: True if they upgraded from a lower level

youtube.memberMilestone.description: Runs when a member shares their milestone message, for example "12 months" of membership. Good for a thank-you.

fields.level: Only run for membership levels whose name has this text in it, like "Gold". Empty runs for every level.
fields.minMonths: Only run when the member has been with you at least this many months. 0 runs for every milestone. Example: 6.

variables.months: How many months they have been a member
variables.message: The message they wrote with it

youtube.membershipGift.description: Runs when someone buys memberships as gifts for others. It runs once for the gifter. Use it to thank them for the whole gift.

fields.level: Only run for membership levels whose name has this text in it, like "Gold". Empty runs for every level.
fields.minTotal: Only run when at least this many memberships were gifted. Example: 5.

youtube.giftMembershipReceived.description: Runs for each person who receives a gifted membership. Good for welcoming the new member.

fields.level: Only run for membership levels whose name has this text in it, like "Gold". Empty runs for every level.

variables.user: Name of the person who received it
variables.gifterName: Name of the person who gifted it

youtube.newSubscriber.description: Runs when someone subscribes to your YouTube channel. Cuebot checks every few minutes and can only see people whose subscriptions are public.

youtube.messageDeleted.description: Runs when a message is deleted from your YouTube live chat.

variables.targetUser: Name of the person who wrote it, if Cuebot saw it
variables.targetMessage: What it said, if Cuebot saw it

youtube.userBanned.description: Runs when someone is banned from your YouTube live chat.

youtube.userTimedOut.description: Runs when someone gets a timeout (a short mute) in your YouTube live chat.

fields.minDuration: Only run when the timeout is at least this many seconds. 0 runs for every timeout. Example: 300.

variables.duration: Length of the timeout in seconds

youtube.sponsorOnlyStarted.description: Runs when members-only chat is turned on, so only your channel members can write.

youtube.sponsorOnlyEnded.description: Runs when members-only chat is turned off, so everyone can write again.

youtube.pollStarted.description: Runs when a poll starts in your YouTube live chat.

variables.pollChoice0Title: Text of the first option (then pollChoice1Title...)

youtube.pollUpdated.description: Runs when the votes in your YouTube chat poll change.

variables.pollChoice0Votes: Votes for the first option (then pollChoice1Votes...)

youtube.pollClosed.description: Runs when a poll in your YouTube live chat ends. Use it to announce the winner.

variables.pollChoice0Title: Text of the first option (then pollChoice1Title...)

youtube.broadcastStarted.description: Runs when your YouTube live stream goes live. Use it to say hello, switch scenes or reset counters.

youtube.broadcastEnded.description: Runs when your YouTube live stream ends. Handy for a goodbye message.

youtube.broadcastMonitoringStarted.description: Runs when Cuebot starts watching a YouTube stream's chat (it finds a live stream, or you connect during one). It is not the same as going live.

youtube.broadcastMonitoringEnded.description: Runs when Cuebot stops watching a YouTube stream's chat, because it ended or you disconnected.

youtube.broadcastAdded.description: Runs when you schedule a new YouTube live stream. Cuebot notices it a few minutes later.

variables.broadcastScheduledStart: When it is planned to start

youtube.broadcastRemoved.description: Runs when a scheduled YouTube live stream is deleted or cancelled before it started.

youtube.broadcastUpdated.description: Runs when the title, description or privacy of your YouTube stream changes.

youtube.broadcastStatisticsUpdated.description: Runs each time Cuebot reads the numbers of your live YouTube stream (about once a minute). Use it to react to viewer counts.

fields.minViewers: Only run when at least this many people watch right now. 0 runs every time. Example: 100.

variables.concurrentViewers: How many people watch right now

youtube.quotaExceeded.description: Runs when Cuebot has used up your daily YouTube limit (quota). YouTube then blocks most requests until the limit resets.

variables.quotaUsed: How much of the limit was used today

youtube.sendMessage.description: Writes a message in your YouTube live chat. You can use variables like %user% in the text.

fields.message: What to write, like "Thanks for watching, %user%!". Messages over 200 letters are cut into several messages.
fields.useBot: Tick to write as your bot account instead of your own account. The bot must be signed in.
fields.fallback: Tick to write as you if the bot account is not signed in or fails. Untick to get an error instead.
fields.broadcastId: Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one.

youtube.deleteMessage.description: Deletes one message from your YouTube live chat.

fields.messageId: ID of the message to delete. The default is the message that started this action.

youtube.banUser.description: Bans someone from your YouTube live chat for good. Needs a live stream.

fields.user: Who to pick: their YouTube channel ID (starts with "UC"), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. The default is the person who started this action.
fields.broadcastId: Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one.

youtube.timeoutUser.description: Gives someone a timeout in your YouTube live chat. They cannot write for a while. Needs a live stream.

fields.user: Who to pick: their YouTube channel ID (starts with "UC"), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. The default is the person who started this action.
fields.duration: How long, in seconds. Example: 300 for 5 minutes.
fields.broadcastId: Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one.

youtube.unbanUser.description: Lifts a ban or timeout. It only works for bans and timeouts Cuebot gave during this session. For others, use YouTube Studio.

fields.user: Who to pick: their YouTube channel ID (starts with "UC"), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. The default is the person who started this action.

youtube.addModerator.description: Makes someone a moderator of your YouTube live chat. Needs a live stream.

fields.user: Who to pick: their YouTube channel ID (starts with "UC"), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. The default is the person who started this action.
fields.broadcastId: Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one.

youtube.removeModerator.description: Takes away someone's moderator role in your YouTube live chat. Needs a live stream.

fields.user: Who to pick: their YouTube channel ID (starts with "UC"), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. The default is the person who started this action.
fields.broadcastId: Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one.

youtube.setTitle.description: Changes the title of your YouTube live stream.

fields.title: The new title, like "Playing with viewers!". It cannot be empty.
fields.broadcastId: Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one.

youtube.setDescription.description: Changes the description text of your YouTube live stream.

fields.description: The new description text. It can have several lines.
fields.broadcastId: Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one.

youtube.setTitleAndDescription.description: Changes the title and the description of your YouTube live stream in one step.

fields.title: The new title, like "Playing with viewers!". It cannot be empty.
fields.description: The new description text. It can have several lines.
fields.broadcastId: Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one.

youtube.setPrivacy.description: Changes who can see your YouTube stream.

fields.privacy: "public" = everyone can find it. "unlisted" = only people with the link. "private" = only you.
fields.broadcastId: Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one.

youtube.setCategory.description: Changes the category of your YouTube stream (the kind of video, like Gaming).

fields.categoryId: YouTube's category number. Examples: 20 for Gaming, 22 for People & Blogs, 10 for Music.
fields.broadcastId: Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one.

youtube.getVideoInfo.description: Looks up a YouTube video or stream and saves its details as variables for the next steps.

fields.videoId: The ID of the video (the part after v= in its web link). Leave empty to use your latest live stream.

youtube.getChannelInfo.description: Looks up a YouTube channel and saves its details as variables for the next steps. Handy for a shout-out command.

fields.user: Who to pick: their YouTube channel ID (starts with "UC"), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. The default is the person who started this action.

youtube.addBroadcasterInfo.description: Saves details about your YouTube account and your bot account as variables for the next steps. It has no settings.

variables.botIsSignedIn: True if the bot account is signed in

youtube.getBroadcast.description: Finds your latest YouTube live stream and saves its details as variables for the next steps. It has no settings.

variables.broadcastIsLive: True if a live stream was found

youtube.createPoll.description: Starts a poll in your YouTube live chat. Viewers vote right in the chat. Needs a live stream.

fields.question: The poll question, like "Which game next?".
fields.options: The answers, one per line. You need 2 to 4.
fields.broadcastId: Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one.

variables.pollMessageId: ID of the poll, to end it later

youtube.endPoll.description: Ends a poll in your YouTube live chat.

fields.pollMessageId: ID of the poll to end. Leave empty to end the poll Cuebot started most recently.
